comment: Brilliant professor that I wish taught more classes outside of excel. Class was fun to come to each day, and he was very entertaining as a 9am lecturer and made class enjoyable. Homework is brutal and can take up to the whole day, but that is a prerequisite for learning this material. Tests/final and excel proficiency are easy because of him
Very helpful course. Decent amount of work outside of class, but none of it is super difficult. The course is more than enough preparation for the excel competency exam.

Professor AbuZayda is a good teacher, but I had a difficult time in the class because the homework was very time-consuming and the class time was not spent (in my opinion) the most efficiently. You just do practice so you essentially teach yourself the entire course. If this is how you learn, this course is great for you. If not, you may struggle.

The class is very beneficial, you'll be overly prepared for the excel competency exam. Just do the online trainings for the modules a couple of times until you understand. Take your time on the projects (use a windows computer) and you'll do fine. He is a great prof, and he is very knowledgeable in excel.

Profesor AbuZayda is amazing!!! I can not say enough good things about him. Very clear and kind. He cares a lot about his students and will teach you everything you need to know about excel. I would recommend his class to everyone.
I agree with everyone else, this is a very useful class and Professor AbuZayda is wonderful. He is one of the kindest, most caring, and most accommodating professor I have ever had.

Professor AbuZayda is probably my favorite professor I have had at UR. It is crystal clear what you need to do in this class to succeed. It is an easy A as long as you apply yourself. I am taking the excel competency exam next week and I am confident that I will succeed on it because I took BUAD 203.

I learned mostly from the online training, but if I was confused about something AbuZayda clearly explained and demonstrated it during class. The take-home practice exams and projects are all pretty easy. All the in-class exams are open book. The final exam is take home.

Dr. AbuZayda is like an Excel wizard. Each class, you work with a parter on a practice project and then he will go over the project. Rinse and repeat each time. There is nothing intuitive about Excel, so he makes learning it very easy by just walking you through how to do everything you need to know step-by-step. Homework is identical to the tests!
Ihab is the absolute homie. He wants to see everyone succeed and is always available for help if you need it. I also learned a lot of excel along the way with the Cengage modules. Take his class!

Prof. AbuZayda is really knowledgeable about excel and is very understanding with his students. Homework can be a little time consuming but not hard if you do the training provided before and pay attention in class. You'll learn a lot in his class and the material will be very useful, definitely worth taking!

Excel is a great skill to have and this covers all the basics and then some. The modules assigned are long and time consuming, but if you do them all then you will do well. Professor AbuZayda is also extremely accessible outside of the classroom and flexible upon reasonable requests.
Prof. AbuZayda is very dedicated and passionate about his work and it comes across in his teaching. He communicates concepts very clearly and is available to answer queries outside class.

This class is one of the most practical classes that I have taken. Before this, I had barely any knowledge on excel, but the material I learned this semester has taught me so much. Now, when I make lists and charts for other classes, I do it only on excel - its the easiest. I would recommend this class to anyone wanting to get proficient in excel.
